name: Garrett Kowalski
bio: Garrett spends most of his year stationed in rural Oregon battling seasonal wildfires, then picks up shifts as an EMT during the off-months. He unwinds by scrolling through relationship drama videos and comedy reels late at night, often sending the funniest ones to his group chat. He recently adopted a retired greyhound named Beans who has claimed the better half of his couch. Despite his stoic demeanor on the job, he is surprisingly sentimental about handwritten letters and keeps a shoebox of them in his closet.
